evidence.notes: Root cause (recon of the two files that own the mechanism): the XFF tests operate on process-wide shared state - the module-level app.main.limiter singleton (slowapi Limiter whose BoundedFrozenClockMemoryStorage counter store is swapped in place via limiter._storage/limiter._limiter and whose enabled flag is toggled by the test-local limiter_on_fresh_store() contextmanager) and the @lru_cache'd app.config.get_settings() singleton whose trusted_proxies field is rewritten in place by the trusted_proxies() contextmanager while app.services.rate_limit.get_rate_limit_key reads it on every request. Isolation is save/restore in test-body contextmanagers rather than fixture-scoped isolation, so what a later test observes depends on what an earlier test's save/restore left behind (the conftest.py autouse disable_limiter fixture reads/writes the same limiter.enabled flag around every test). Design: replace both contextmanagers with pytest-fixture-scoped isolation (dedicated limiter/storage instance or reference override; monkeypatch-style settings override), matching the suite's established patterns; no backend/app changes.
